mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees at the Verona Public Library with clear skies. The moon is a Waxing Crescent, and you can catch the space station passing overhead starting at 4:47 AM, rising over Belleville and moving toward Fitchburg while staying low on the horizon.

The Verona Senior Center is looking for volunteers to assist with their programs, provided you can commit to at least two shifts a month. Meanwhile, road construction on Highway M begins on August 18th, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks as utility work takes place.

Today, Epic Systems is hosting their User Group Meeting, and you can also check out yoga at Insight Wellness. Starting tomorrow, trivia fans can head to Hop Haus Brewing or Wisconsin Brewing Company for quiz nights.
On August 5th, officers arrested a man on Whalen Road for a probation violation after he attempted to flee custody.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Since the store is currently closed, please note they open at 10:00 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Caramel Chocolate Pecan flavor.
